sentence: [Ryan2024] point to the difficulty of reconciling individual, organizational, and state claims to control in data spaces, and [Baur2025] show how a sovereignty initiative can remain dependent on dominant cloud providers.

sentence: Regulations written for controlled, centralized processing are not yet well adapted to distributed architectures, which is a concern raised in the sovereignty debate [Carrapico2025].
supporting_passage: "the enforceability of these provisions is open to question"; p. 11: hard for the EU to monitor compliance
note: source never discusses centralised vs distributed architectures; that part of the sentence is the review's own assessment. Source does show a rule-practice gap (operationalising DA/DGA sovereignty ambitions). Calibration question: may review_assessment carry T1?
